PrayerClock

Tester builds of PrayerClock (ساعة الصلاة) for Android, signed by the developer. Prayer times, prayer-relative alarms, qibla and tasbih.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://abdibr116.github.io/prayerclock-fdroid/repo
